title: Update orchestrator.ts — Dynamic provider config resolution
description: Replace flat activeConfig fields (ollamaEndpoint, ollamaModel, etc.) with dynamic resolution from providerConfigs map. updateConfig must accept new AppSettings format. resolveProviderConfig should lookup from providerConfigs[provider] instead of switch statement. getEngine() KeyStore should work with any provider ID, not just openai/anthropic.
resolution: orchestrator.ts updated to dynamic provider config resolution. Flat activeConfig replaced with providerConfigs map, resolveProviderConfig uses lookup instead of switch, KeyStore is generic.
